repository.direct_push_policy: avoid for normal code, config, workflow, and release changes

advisory_gates: npm test when a real test script exists
credentialed shadow smoke when target and credentials are configured
branch_protection_recommendations: require pull request before merging to main
require CI / Web build and release bundle
run the Release Bundle workflow for release candidates
require at least one human review for release-impacting changes
dismiss stale approvals when workflow, dependency, or deploy files change

deploy.rollback_strategy: re-promote previous successful web artifact or revert the PR that introduced the regression
deploy.live_deploy_mutation: not allowed from this baseline hardening node

product.primary_journey: sign in, create a task, complete it, and see persisted progress feedback

agile.planning_model: PR-sized increments with explicit problem framing before major feature or release-policy work
definition_of_ready: target user and customer problem are named
critical user journey and failure modes are documented
affected protected surfaces and rollout boundary are named
acceptance criteria, verification expectations, and rollback path are written
definition_of_done: changes are delivered through branch -> PR -> checks -> reviewed merge
required gates in .jarvis/verification_contract.json pass or have documented blockers
release-readiness notes are updated for CI, deploy, rollback, or verification changes
residual risks and follow-up owners are recorded

cadence.retro_trigger: after failed release gates, rollback, or repeated advisory-gate failures

protected_surfaces: auth routing and AuthContext session hydration
calendar event creation and Google Calendar sync boundary
CI, deploy, rollback, and verification policy
architecture.adr_policy: Create an ADR before changing auth, persistence, deployment target, package manager, data model, or release automation behavior.

verification.test_status: blocked until package.json defines a real test script

release.promotion_model: reviewable artifact only; live deploy requires a separate reviewed integration
release.rollback_action: re-promote previous successful web artifact or revert the release PR, then check /health and rerun available auth/task smoke checks

reliability.healthcheck_status: documented but not implemented or locally verified in the static web export
reliability.primary_smoke: sign in, create a task, complete it, and verify persisted progress feedback
reliability.observability_gap: no repo-local production metrics, alert, or dashboard contract is defined yet

next_ratchet: turn .jarvis/agile_work_item.json into issue and PR automation once the team agrees on required fields
add focused regression tests for auth, first task completion, habit creation, and calendar creation
triage critical dependency audit findings without changing runtime behavior casually
map or implement /health on the target runtime and add credentialed shadow smoke
clean lint warnings in behavior-preserving PRs
wire the repo-local operating-system report into CI once the advisory contract stabilizes

risk_register.impact: CI cannot prove task, habit, auth, calendar, or leaderboard behavior beyond lint, typecheck, and build.
risk_register.next_action: Add focused tests around critical user journeys before feature expansion.

risk_register.risk: Dependency audit reports 55 known findings, including 3 critical.
risk_register.impact: Release owners cannot yet distinguish exploitable runtime risk from transitive build-tool risk.
risk_register.next_action: Triage audit findings and remediate through a separate dependency plan with build and smoke evidence.

risk_register.impact: Unused imports and hook dependency warnings remain visible regression debt.
risk_register.next_action: Clean warnings in small behavior-preserving PRs or document intentional hook dependency boundaries.

risk_register.risk: The deploy healthcheck path is contracted but not locally verified.
risk_register.impact: A live release may pass artifact build while failing service health checks.
risk_register.next_action: Implement or map /health in the target runtime, then add smoke verification.

risk_register.risk: Release automation creates an artifact but intentionally does not perform live deploys.
risk_register.impact: A human or future deploy integration must promote artifacts and record target evidence.
risk_register.next_action: Add a credentialed shadow deploy workflow only after target CLI, credentials, health check, and rollback target are reviewed.
